title: Add min/mean delta and min jitter, to the RTP analysis.
description:
Shows min/mean/max delta, and min/mean/max jitter in both the
tshark output and Qt GUI.

Show 3 decimal points in the tshark delta ad jitter output, to
show more accuracy.

Fix the RTP mean jitter calculation, which was dividing by
the wrong denominator. It was dividing by the number of packets
instead of the number of diffs (packets - 1).

Fix the build when built without libpcap support;
openTelephonyRtpPlayerDialog() has no access to captureSession.

notes.body:
Presumably "and thus, the first *delta*"?

And, presumably, when we arrive here, `total_nr` will never be 0?

Ahh, yes, I'll fix that typo. Correct; the first packet is handled separately, incrementing total_nr from 0 to 1, so when we get here, the minimum value of total_nr is 1. I'll add more to the comment to explain that.
